name: Michael Zheng
intro: Michael Zheng is an American from New Jersey. He just finished college at Columbia in New York City. He is the local kid in this tournament.
story: As a kid, Michael rode a bus and subway to practice in Queens. He won the college national title two years in a row. This year he played all four Grand Slams, the biggest tournaments. He got into the US Open with a wild card, a special invitation. He has won twice so far!

funFacts.text: He won the college national title twice. His school's first since 1906!
He kept great grades in college while playing pro tennis.
He once flew overnight after a tournament, then took a test the next morning.
In middle school he rode a bus and subway 90 minutes to train in Queens.
His dad Joe is a big Roger Federer fan. His big sister Amy plays tennis too.
He missed his college graduation because he was playing the French Open.
His coach says nothing seems to bother him, on or off the court.

watchFor: Look for his college friends cheering, and his calm face after every point.

notes: Born 27 Jan 2004, raised in Montville NJ, 188 cm, right-handed/two-handed backhand, NCAA singles champion 2024 + 2025 (Columbia's first since 1906), parents Joe and Mei from Hubei, China, all four 2026 Slams, ranking 107: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Zheng + atptour.com bio.
